name: cpbooster
author: searleser97
description: cpbooster is a cross-platform CLI tool for cloning contests, organizing files, and testing solutions locally

scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/index.js test -h
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc && node -e "require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/src/index.js', 0o755)"
scripts.install:dev: npm run build && npm uninstall cpbooster -g && npm install -g
